props.text: How does AI read your text?

captions.text: Turning words into numbers is called tokenization.
The full stop becomes its own piece.
Every model has a fixed list of word pieces it knows, called its vocabulary.
“Matters” is on the shelf, but “tokenization” is not.
So it is built from smaller pieces.
It takes the longest piece that fits: To, then ##ken, then ##ization.
[CLS] goes at the front, and [SEP] goes at the end.
The model gathers a summary of the whole sentence into [CLS].

shots.label: SWAP EACH TOKEN FOR A NUMBER

captions.text: The number has no meaning by itself.
So two words became seven tokens, and then seven numbers.
So always count tokens with your model's own tokenizer.
